bullets.text: Task completeness: Identify the task's required result and trace how the Plan's proposed output will be used. Reject if a material stated requirement remains unmet.
Factual grounding: Identify repository facts essential to the Plan's approach; inspect the relevant files and tracked artifacts. Reject if a material premise is false.
Behavior preservation: Compare the Plan's proposed change with existing accepted and rejected cases in the code or tests. Reject if it materially breaks an established boundary.
